description: One CSP-blocked script on several pages, each page with its own nonce and cache-buster (Frameva, field item F44): one finding per rule that lists the pages; a page with a genuinely different error stays its own finding. A page with a strict nonce CSP for scripts and styles (Task 15): axe still runs there, and Jourilo's own instrumentation is never reported as the site's console error.

mustFind.why: inline script blocked by a per-page CSP nonce plus React error #418 on four pages (the near-miss page logs the same errors): one collapsed finding
the e-mail decoder script and the same product image fail on three pages with a per-page ?v= cache-buster: one collapsed finding
near miss: same CSP, decoder and nonce pattern, but a different product image, a readable name that differs only in letters and digits, so it is its own finding
a different error message is its own finding, not part of the collapse
a different failing URL is its own finding, not part of the collapse
an icon-only share button with no accessible name on a page whose CSP allows only nonce scripts and styles: axe must run despite the CSP

mustNotFind.why: the home page has no CSP and no errors
the home page loads nothing that fails
the strict-CSP page runs only its own nonce script, which works; a CSP refusal of Jourilo's injected axe or of Playwright's screenshot style is not a site error
the strict-CSP page loads nothing that fails
